answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the voyage of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A onyx of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, published publicly on failure, no identity may audit its own recruit.
